stem.firstresponse.depth_cycle_stationar: The peak and released heights match, so the chest stays {depth} cm below rest throughout this cycle. Movement per push is 0.0 cm, and no direction arrow is shown. Lower depression at release or increase peak depth to compare movement.
stem.firstresponse.depth_graph_help: Tap or drag across the graph to freeze the same moment in 3D. Arrow keys move 1%; Page Up and Page Down move 10%; Home and End select the start and release.
stem.firstresponse.depth_graph_scale: 0 cm is the resting height. The scale increases downward and changes with age.
stem.firstresponse.depth_graph_compariso: Saved A: {a} cm · Current B: {b} cm · Difference: {difference} cm.
